description.en: The handwritten Type 82 ordinary passport, issued from the early 1980s until the Type 92 series was introduced.
description.zh: 82版普通护照自20世纪80年代初开始签发，采用手写资料，之后由92版接替。

detail.en: Black textured cover with the state title, national emblem and passport name arranged vertically.
detail.zh: 黑色压纹封面，国名、国徽和“护照”采用纵向层级排布。

detail.en: Personal information was handwritten; Chinese, French and English appeared throughout the booklet.
detail.zh: 个人资料采用手写形式，内页同时使用中文、法文和英文。

detail.en: The series predated electronic chips and relied on physical printing, seals and manual issuance controls.
detail.zh: 该版本早于电子芯片时代，主要依赖纸张印刷、印章和人工签发管理。

detail.en: This was a pre-machine-readable passport without the modern two-line MRZ.
detail.zh: 属于非机读护照，尚未采用现代护照底部的两行机读区。

description.en: The Type 92 series introduced a burgundy cover and a more standardized bilingual cover layout, but remained non-machine-readable.
description.zh: 92版改用酒红色封面并统一中英文信息层级，但仍属于非机读护照。

detail.en: The cover changed from black to burgundy and added a clearer bilingual title hierarchy beneath the emblem.
detail.zh: 封面由黑色改为酒红色，国徽下方形成更清晰的中英文标题层级。

detail.en: A standardized Type 92 booklet replaced the handwritten-era format, while retaining a non-MRZ data structure.
detail.zh: 标准化的92版证件取代早期手写时代格式，但资料结构仍未加入机读区。

detail.en: Printing and booklet production became more standardized; there was still no contactless biometric chip.
detail.zh: 印刷和证件制作进一步标准化，但仍未配备非接触式生物识别芯片。

detail.en: The Type 92 ordinary passport was not machine-readable.
detail.zh: 92版普通护照仍不符合现代机读护照格式。

description.en: The Type 97-1 series marked the move toward machine-readable ordinary passports and was issued until the next 97-series revision.
description.zh: 97-1版代表普通护照向机读格式过渡，并持续签发至下一次97系列改版。

detail.en: The emblem and titles were tightened into a more compact burgundy-cover composition.
detail.zh: 国徽和中英文标题收紧为更紧凑的酒红色封面构图。

detail.en: The series moved personal data toward printed, machine-readable processing.
detail.zh: 个人资料开始转向印刷式和机读化处理。

detail.en: Document inspection became less dependent on handwritten information and manual visual checks alone.
detail.zh: 证件查验不再只依赖手写信息和人工目视检查。

detail.en: This generation formed part of China's transition to ICAO-style machine-readable passports.
detail.zh: 这一代属于中国普通护照向 ICAO 机读护照规范过渡的阶段。

description.en: The last major non-biometric ordinary series before the nationwide biometric passport launch in May 2012.
description.zh: 2012年5月全国启用生物识别护照之前，最后一个主要非生物识别普通护照版本。

detail.en: The cover enlarged and clarified the state title, emblem and English passport label.
detail.zh: 封面进一步放大并明确国名、国徽和英文 PASSPORT 标识。

detail.en: Personal data was placed on the inside front cover with an inkjet-printed colour photograph and a machine-readable zone.
detail.zh: 个人资料位于封二，使用喷墨彩色照片，并加入机读区。

detail.en: A protective film covered most of the data page to make physical alteration more evident.
detail.zh: 资料页大部分区域覆盖保护膜，使物理篡改更容易被识别。

detail.en: The machine-readable code supported automated border inspection; the 2007 Passport Law also standardized validity periods.
detail.zh: 机读码支持自动化边检；2007年施行的《护照法》同时规范了有效期。

description.en: China began issuing ordinary biometric passports nationwide on 15 May 2012, adding a contactless chip and redesigned data page.
description.zh: 中国自2012年5月15日起正式签发电子普通护照，加入非接触式芯片并重新设计资料页。

detail.en: The international ePassport symbol was added to the cover and the internal data-page design was substantially revised.
detail.zh: 封面新增国际电子护照标志，内部资料页设计大幅调整。

detail.en: The data page moved to a separate sheet and biometric identity data could be stored in the chip.
detail.zh: 资料页移至独立页面，生物识别身份信息可写入芯片。

detail.en: A contactless chip, digital certificate, ghost portrait, holographic graphics and laser-printed map strengthened authentication.
detail.zh: 非接触式芯片、数字证书、第二人像、全息图案和激光地图共同增强真伪验证。

detail.en: The ordinary passport became an ICAO-compatible biometric ePassport.
detail.zh: 普通护照升级为符合 ICAO 规范的生物识别电子护照。
